# Kartikesh Mishra

> Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer at Lamina AI (YC). MIT EECS M.Eng. ('25) in AI/ML, MIT B.S. ('24) in Computer Science & Engineering and Mathematics. Researcher in Vision-Language Navigation, Reinforcement Learning, and Applied Mathematics.

## Overview
Kartikesh Mishra is the Co-Founder and CTO of Lamina AI, a Y Combinator-backed company building the visualization layer for AI to bring visual explanation everywhere text is today. Previously, he was a software engineer at Abacus AI working on deep research agents at scale (2M+ users) and a founding engineer at Infinirate building distributed real-time agent infrastructure.

He earned his Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (AI/ML) and dual Bachelor of Science degrees in Computer Science & Engineering and Mathematics from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). At MIT CSAIL's Distributed Robotics Lab under Prof. Daniela Rus, he authored his thesis on compositional vision-language navigation for autonomous drones with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. He also conducted research in RL-based inverse imaging solvers at MIT EECS and mechanistic interpretability / ordinal rank probing at the Tegmark AI Safety Group.
